  "pros": [
    "The platform is easy to set up and manage, which is crucial for handling multiple e-commerce websites.",
    "Offers a good range of built-in features that support sales and account management.",
    "The ability to apply bulk discounts is very beneficial for wholesale operations."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Experienced some initial friction with setup and integrations, potentially with ERP systems.",
    "Random glitches can occasionally disrupt the smooth operation of the e-commerce sites.",
    "Finds that themes and the store interface are not always easy to customize to specific needs."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This National Account Manager has found BigCommerce to be a generally positive tool for setting up and managing e-commerce websites. They appreciate its ease of use and valuable built-in features, especially for wholesale operations. While occasional glitches and customization limitations are noted, the platform largely meets their needs for robust online sales management."
